```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><noscript><p>secret noscript text</p></noscript><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
